note: Ten change requests against repo/, each with the files a correct change writes. The write sets were fixed by reading the code, before any predictor ran, and include the tests and docs a finished change touches (0019: done includes tests). Constructed by the same author as the predictor, so it measures the instrument, not the central bet at scale.

tasks.text: Support negative amounts in parse_amount: accept a leading minus sign.
Add a thousands separator to format_amount, switched on by a new Config setting.
Refuse to post to a closed account: post_entry must return an error when the Account is closed.
Add close_account, which closes an account and writes an audit record.
Quote fields that contain commas when exporting CSV in export_csv.
Add a --since option to the command line that limits the report to entries on or after a date.
Group the totals in render_report by currency.
Allow comment lines that start with # in imported ledger files.
Let an environment variable override the rounding setting that load_config reads.
Keep the source line number on each Entry so that parse errors can name the line.
